observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon EOS 600D body with lens cap mounted next to a Canon EF-S 18-55mm lens on a white shelf.
Photo 1 shows the rear of the same Canon EOS 600D with its flip-out LCD screen open.
Photo 2 shows the same Canon EOS 600D on the left next to a Canon EOS 700D on the right.
The text "Canon" and "EOS 600D" is legible on the camera body in photos 0, 1, and 2.
The lens text "Canon EF-S 18-55mm" is legible in photos 0 and 1.
A watermark "POSTED ON JIJI KJ-TECH" appears across all photos.

claims.evidence: Model name legible on camera body in photos 0, 1, and 2.
No photo shows import documents, UK origin marks, or provenance.
Photos show exterior condition only; optical sharpness and function cannot be confirmed from still images.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, shutter may be faulty, or buttons/screen may not work.
risks.proof: Video of camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image.

risks.risk: Image sensor may have fungus, dust, or damage.
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with mirror locked up, or a sample image shot at a small aperture.

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, separation, or focus issues.
risks.proof: Front and rear element photos of the 18-55mm lens plus a focus test.
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or software.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, strap, or other accessories may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories together.

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image.
Photo of image sensor with mirror raised.
Front and rear photos of the 18-55mm lens elements.
Screenshot of shutter count or menu showing usage.
response.reason: The Canon EOS 600D is clearly identifiable from the body text in multiple photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-functional pending proof.
